claim_boundary: Every required intervention is reported. Only DEM calibration and bias correction are measured on the frozen campaign; inactive or unavailable production branches are explicitly not applicable and are not assigned invented metrics.

backbone_substitution.reason: No alternative backbone checkpoint satisfies the identical-input, absolute-datum and freeze-before-reference contract for these five scenes.

bias_correction.intervention: remove the resolution-limited low-frequency terrain-bias field

confidence_weighting.reason: DA3MONO-LARGE supplied no probability-calibrated native confidence product in these runs, so production used the explicit no-confidence fallback.

dem_calibration.intervention: remove all metric DEM scale/datum mapping

gcp_calibration.reason: The frozen campaign selected the DEM-only production branch; no surveyed GCP evidence was available, and synthesizing GCPs from references would be leakage.

global_vs_per_tile_normalization.reason: Production exposes one scene-global affine mosaic contract, not an alternative per-tile metric-normalization branch; fabricating post-hoc tile surfaces from the persisted mosaic would not be a valid intervention.

learned_refinement.reason: The independently evaluated learned refiner failed its non-degradation promotion gate and is intentionally absent from production.

seam_harmonization.reason: Only the final harmonized scene mosaics were frozen. A valid intervention needs a separately regenerated unharmonized prediction set; no post-hoc proxy is claimed.

semantic_priors.reason: No semantic-prior branch is active in the frozen calibrated-DA3 production path.
